name: Yamaha SMAX / XMAX
engine: 155 or 292 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: Yamaha's modern maxi-scooters. 2018-2022 XMAXs have a cam retainer bolt recall that NHTSA flagged do-not-ride.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018-2022 XMAXs are in recall 25V778 (camshaft retainer bolt). 2018-2020 XMAXs are in 20V611 (rear reflector) and some 2019-2020 bikes in 21V048 (VIN label).
A-002.reason: The cam bolt can stall the engine. All fixes are free.

recalls.what: Camshaft retainer bolt can loosen and the cam can come loose, stalling the engine.
Condensation can collect on the rear reflector lens and make it less effective.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.

recalls.what: VIN on the federal certification label may not match the frame.
recalls.fix: Dealer checks and replaces the label free.
